::: {#sol-iff-values}

| $n$ | $n$ is even | $n$ is divisible by $3$ | biconditional |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| $6$ | T | T | T |
| $4$ | T | F | F |
| $5$ | F | F | T |

By @def-iff, the biconditional is true exactly when its two sides have the same truth value.
When $n = 5$, both sides are false, so the biconditional is true.

:::
